company.name: Aqua Voice
company.shortDescription: Aqua Voice is an AI dictation company building fast, accurate speech-to-text for Mac, Windows, and iPhone.
company.description:
Aqua Voice, Inc. is a San Francisco–based AI company developing fast, accurate voice dictation software that turns speech into clean, formatted text in any application across Mac, Windows, and iPhone. The product is powered by Avalon, the company's proprietary speech model, which combines audio understanding with large language models to transcribe intent — including punctuation, formatting, and technical vocabulary — across 49 languages. Aqua also offers the Avalon API for developers building voice and transcription features into their own products.

Founded in 2023 by Finn Brown and Jack McIntire, Aqua Voice is a Y Combinator (W24) company backed by investors including Pioneer Fund, 1517 Fund, and Assembly Capital Partners. Its tools are used by developers, technical writers, and other professionals who want to write faster by voice.
